programs.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programs.desc: Guy Fieri kicks off Game Day as the reigning champ faces Torrence Chef T Gregoire and Joe Flamm in tackling fan-favorite flavors; judges Marcel Vigneron and Marcus Samuelsson are calling the plays and only one chef can win up to $20,000.

programs.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programs.desc: Guy Fieri has declared it Fry Day, and the returning champion takes on Jacob Town and Taylor Frankel in an epic battle for golden brown and delicious domination; Judges Mei Lin and Maneet Chauhan decide which chef takes home the gold and up to $20,000.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.desc: Four GGG winners return to Guy Fieri's Flavortown for a chance to take another crown in one big round; they must make a winner's dinner complete with an appetizer and entrée in an hourlong battle to shop the market for up to $20,000.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.desc: Guy invites three chefs with previous wins to go head-to-head in a showdown of international flavors; the competitors must shop in Flavortown Market's new international section, where all the labels are in different languages.
